en: Halo-halo is a heterogeneous mixture containing distinct solid ingredients like sweetened beans, gulaman, and crushed ice.
Tamarind broth in sinigang is a homogeneous liquid solution where sour flavors and salts dissolve completely in water.
Fermenting coconut sap into tuba vinegar is a chemical change that produces new acidic substances.
Solid coconut oil melts into a clear liquid when heated, demonstrating a reversible physical change.
Abaca fibers extracted from Musa textilis plants possess high tensile strength, making them ideal for marine ropes.
Molten lava erupting from Mayon Volcano is a liquid that cools into solid igneous rock.
Sun-drying bangus in Dagupan physically removes water through evaporation to preserve the fish.
A South Sea pearl from Palawan is a solid material primarily composed of calcium carbonate.
The corrugated iron roof of a rural house in Batanes undergoes a chemical change called rusting when exposed to rain.
Muddy water from the Pasig River after a typhoon is a heterogeneous suspension containing undissolved soil particles.
Helium gas fills floating balloons at the Sinulog Festival because it is less dense than surrounding air.
Bamboo stems have a hollow cylindrical structure that provides high compressive strength for building scaffolds.
